# Ayu Palette

Ayu Palette ships the three Ayu palettes, Light, Mirage and Dark, and lets a user choose which of them Obsidian's light and dark modes map to. Typography is likewise selectable through the Style Settings plugin, with presets for the interface, for note text and for code, defaulting to the system interface font, Sentient and Maple Mono.

![Ayu Palette screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iodic/obsidian-ayu-theme/HEAD/theme-screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ayu Palette"
    author: "iodic"
    repo:   "iodic/obsidian-ayu-theme"
    slug:   "ayu-palette"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ayu-palette"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/iodic/obsidian-ayu-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iodic/obsidian-ayu-theme/HEAD/theme-screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Ayu Palette to switch between three palettes — Light, Mirage, Dark — with configurable mapping for Obsidian light and dark modes. Select typography presets for interface (system UI), text (Sentient) and code (Maple Mono) via Style Settings."
}
```
